name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Tunic
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Tunic: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The ultimate symbol of a haruspex's power is what they wear, friend. Of these, the tunic symbolizes the connection between themselves and the divine wisdom they seek. It often weaves parts of the beasties they sacrifice into the tunic; this reminds them of the connection they have to their gifts.
Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this, and a tunic seeping with the true power of a haruspex is yours.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Got the necessary Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub? The haruspex's tunic is well worth any effort ya be needin' to make.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive... You've successfully collected the required Paragons of Power, friend. Your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub for the Zandalar are legendary; hence forth, you'll be revered amongst the tribe. Here is your tunic, mighty adventurer!
